cta: See how your health history could connect.
caption: Your health data isn't rows and columns. It's a story with dates, and in the Health Graph that story has a shape you can move through. Drag to travel through time, pinch to zoom. Twelve nodes, twenty two connections, all your own days. See how your health history could connect. #HealthGraph #HealthData #HealthHistory #DigitalHealth #DataVisualization #SelfTracking #PersonalHealth #ConnectedHealth

lines.beat: abstract spreadsheet-style grid of generic health entries fills the frame, rows flickering

lines.text: It's not rows and columns. It's a story with dates.
lines.beat: cell values blur into highlighted dates; the grid loses its spreadsheet feel

lines.text: Every visit, every measurement, every logged day lives in your history.
lines.beat: scattered document, measurement, and sleep cards drift in from the frame edges

lines.text: In a spreadsheet, that story hides in cells.
lines.beat: the cards snap into a rigid table grid, then dim under cold light

lines.text: In a graph, it has a shape.
lines.beat: the grid dissolves; glowing edges begin to draw between the cards

lines.text: This is the Health Graph: twelve nodes, twenty two connections.
lines.beat: real health-graph screen reveals, showing 12 nodes and 22 connections

lines.text: All of it from your own logged days.
lines.beat: slow push-in on health-graph nodes; the legend Event, Visit, Heart, Sleep, Nutrition stays in frame

lines.text: Drag, and travel through time. Pinch, and zoom into one day.
lines.beat: drag gesture on the health-graph, nodes slide through time; pinch gesture zooms into the 3 OCT node

lines.text: Same data. Now you can see it move.
lines.beat: split compare: faded spreadsheet on the left, living graph on the right

lines.text: See how your health history could connect.
lines.beat: end card on warm charcoal, graph motif behind the CTA
